prompt: Two angles are supplementary. One measures $118°$. What is the measure, in degrees, of the other?
explanation: Supplementary angles add to $180°$ — they form a straight line.
Complementary angles, by contrast, add to $90°$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Keeping the two words apart
steps: Complementary comes before supplementary alphabetically, and $90$ comes before $180$ numerically.
That ordering is enough to keep them straight under time pressure.
Choosing the wrong one here gives $-28$, which is obviously impossible — so a quick plausibility check catches the mix-up too.
